description: Paid pre-payment trust gate. Use after create_ap2_challenge and after receiving the merchant's real x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge, but before paying the merchant. Verifies AP2 v0.2 authority and binds approval to the exact merchant challenge and HTTP request. On approval returns authorization_token; next pay the merchant, then call verify_settlement. Machine price: $0.001 via x402. If authorization is denied, the Trust fee is not settled/charged.

ap2_authority.description: AP2 authority proof for this exact purchase attempt.

challenge_token.description: Short-lived challenge token obtained from create_ap2_challenge and bound into the AP2 proof.

payment_mandate_chain.description: AP2 v0.2 SD-JWT/KB-SD-JWT Payment Mandate delegation chain.

trusted_root_jwks.description: Trusted P-256 public root JWKs used to verify the AP2 delegation chain.

category.description: Service/purchase category evaluated against the AP2 mandate constraints, for example ai-infrastructure.

merchant_id.description: Stable identifier for the merchant/resource being authorized.

nonce.description: Optional caller nonce for correlation; do not reuse across distinct purchase attempts.

payer.description: Base payer wallet address that will authorize the merchant x402 payment.

payment_required.description: Merchant's real x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED payload, either as the decoded object or the original encoded/string form.

request.description: Exact HTTP request the agent intends to execute after approval; changing it invalidates the authorization binding.

body.description: Exact request body to bind to the authorization, when present.

method.description: HTTP method of the exact merchant request, for example POST.

url.description: Absolute merchant resource URL that produced the x402 challenge.

name: authorize_x402_ap2
